medium: Acrylic on paper, plywood, stepper motors, microprocessor, camera, custom software
deskripsi:
This installation consists of a series of robotic flower modules mounted on a panel. Each unit is designed with
folding “petals” that remain closed in their default state, concealing the painted surface inside.
When activated via a sensor system (gesture-based hand movement), the mechanism triggers the petals to open
sequentially. As each module unfolds, sections of the painting are gradually revealed. This creates a controlled,
step-by-step viewing experience rather than presenting the artwork all at once."
